name: writing-plans
tagline_zh: 拿到需求别急着写码，先让 AI 把多步任务拆成可视化计划。像看地图一样看清每一步，改起来比改代码快十倍。
tagline_en: Got a spec? Don't code yet. Turn multi-step tasks into a visual plan you can tweak faster than code.
desc_en: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code
why_zh: 同类工具只给清单，它把计划变成可交互的图，改一步自动联动后续，省去反复推倒重来。
why_en: Others give checklists; this turns plans into interactive maps where edits ripple automatically, saving you from rework.
